gen-nixie-one-gf-sarala: Nostalgic wire-thin lines from Nixie One lead, each curve left open with a visible gap. Sarala follows with the friendlier build of its own, gaps in every c, e and s, so paragraphs stay easy going.
gen-nixie-one-gf-shippori-antique-b1: Retro-tech and glowing, Nixie One draws every curve open at a constant stroke. Shippori Antique B1 does the quiet work, letting daylight into each rounded opening while the heading handles the flourish.
gen-nixie-one-gf-spinnaker: Thin, wirelike strokes of one thickness give Nixie One a retro-tech glow, with curves that never quite close. Spinnaker's openness is the hook.
gen-nixie-one-gf-stick:
Nixie One draws hairline curves that stay open, never pinching shut.

Stick carries the text in tubelike lines of constant weight, and its wide exits let paragraphs pass along smoothly without clogging.
gen-nixie-one-gf-tajawal:
Nixie One's strokes never swell or thin, just one steady line.

Tajawal follows with a broad, open hook in its c, so a full page of text moves along quietly and without friction.
gen-nixie-one-gf-tenor-sans: Nixie One draws its curves in one unvarying stroke, with no swell at the turns. Tenor Sans adds a faint thick-and-thin shift beneath, so give it a size a notch above the heading's usual comfort.
gen-nixie-one-gf-tirra:
Nostalgic and wire-thin, Nixie One looks cut from strips.

Tirra's round forms read like open parentheses, so give it a generous size under the heading to let those curves breathe.
gen-nixie-one-gf-tsukimi-rounded: Nostalgic and retro-tech, Nixie One keeps its curves open and its stroke constant from top to baseline. Tsukimi Rounded sits below it.
gen-nixie-one-gf-urbanist: Retro wire, drawn in a single line. Nixie One sets that nostalgic tone up top, and Urbanist follows with a smooth, broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut, giving the heading something modern to lean on.
gen-nixie-one-gf-wix-madefor-display: Thin, ribbon-cut retro charm: Nixie One keeps its curves open and its stroke ends looking sliced from one strip. And Wix Madefor Display answers with gently flared curve ends that stay apart, keeping everything modern underneath.
